title: Ah you get what to pay for
text: Ah you get what to pay for. I was tempted by the price and that was a bad idea. The curtain is very thin, not a sturdy material at all. I already had to toss it after not even 2 months. I think this is more for a guest bathroom that doesn't get a lot of use, but for daily showers of a main bathroom.

product_metadata.title: Titanker Extra Long Shower Curtain Liner 72 x 84 Plastic Frosted Shower Liner Waterproof Shower Curtain Liner PEVA Shower Curtains for Bathroom with Magnets and Rustproof Metal Grommets
features: Lightweight and waterproof: The shower curtain liner is lightweight, which is easy to wipe. The smooth shower liner is waterproof and drained quickly, keeping your bathroom dry and clean.

Durable and rustproof: The shower curtain liner can be hung and taken out easily because of 12 metal grommet holes. The plastic shower curtain liner can keep the liner from tearing. Compatible with many standard size shower rods.
Magnets design: With 3 magnets at the bottom, the inside shower curtain liner will prevent water from seeping out into the rest of your bathroom and keep the bathroom curtain liner in place.
Eco-friendly material: The shower curtain with liner is made of high quality and eco-friendly PEVA material, which can provide you a comfortable shower experience.
Where to use: The shower curtain liner with magnets is great for your bathroom or dorms, hotels, and more. The shower curtain liner can be used alone or paired with a decorative shower curtain.
